item: 3.7 follow-up — a replayed edit card quotes the note it was rejected with, as the plan card does (2026-09-05)
branch: SessionStore.applyToolResult extracts the deny message into `planFeedback` for a denied EDIT item too (not just a plan), skipping the stock REJECT_MESSAGE and the CLI's abort prefix; fillAppliedCard draws `✗ Rejected` + fbQuote(planFeedback) on a denied diff card. A denied item without a note stays a plain `✗ Rejected`.
provenance: Item shape is the panel's own __transcript wire (SessionStore → ChatPanel), self-consistency for the shape; the FACT it rests on is measured — the user's 2026-09-05 transcript e5d6aaf2… carries the typed note verbatim as the denied Edit's is_error tool_result, and `SessionStoreDeniedEditTest` pins the parser's extraction on that real file. The user's screenshot showed the replayed card reading a bare `✗ Rejected` while the model's reply quoted the note. Negative control on the build before this change: step 1's quoted footer reads plain `✗ Rejected` — DISCRIMINATING; step 2 is a GUARD on both builds.
